nodes.name: Deploy Webhook
nodes.notes: The door's ONLY entry (ruling 2026-09-03). The daily feed lives in Airtable now, as Schedule Live View Deploys, which creates the launch row and POSTs {recordId} here, so a scheduled deploy and a hand launch are the same run.

nodes.name: Prepare
nodes.notes: Mode prepare, awaited, error left to travel: resolves the launch row into client, base, campaign, mirror row, table, view and the field contract, drops DNC domains, applies the run cap and hands back the prospects shaped as merge variables. A failure inside it fails this run, which is the run the Error Logger names.

nodes.name: Any Prospects?
nodes.notes: Nothing to push is not a failure: a refused launch and a view where every row was skipped both go straight to the close, which stamps the rows and writes the row.

nodes.name: Push Prospect
nodes.notes: The one thing this door does that nothing else can: one prospect per request into the campaign's audience webhook, paced at one every 8 seconds (faster bursts draw IP-level 429s).

nodes.name: Finish
nodes.notes: Mode finish, awaited, error left to travel: stamps Deploy Error and the Campaigns links on the source rows, writes the Lead Lists receipt and writes this run's Hub row, upserted on this execution's id. A failed log write crashes it, and with it this run.
